evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC endpoints in src/rpc/mempool.cpp, src/rpc/fees.cpp, src/rpc/net.cpp, and src/rpc/client.cpp.
rationale: Adds an optional `sat_vb` argument to feerate-reporting RPCs to format feerates in sat/vB rather than BTC/kvB. This addresses downstream tooling convenience and avoids floating-point conversion pitfalls, though callers can already compute this externally.
